title: At the Park
text:
Ali and Zeynep are in a park. Ali says, 'Hello, Zeynep!' Zeynep says, 'Hi, Ali. Do you like the park?' Ali says, 'Yes, I do. It is big and green.'

Zeynep asks, 'Do you want to play ball?' Ali says, 'Yes, let us play!' They play ball together. They are happy.

questions.text: What do Ali and Zeynep play?
How does Ali feel about the park?
How do Ali and Zeynep feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a green place outside where people walk and play

paragraph_translations: Ali ve Zeynep bir parktalar. Ali, 'Merhaba, Zeynep!' diyor. Zeynep, 'Selam, Ali. Parkı sever misin?' diyor. Ali, 'Evet, severim. Büyük ve yeşil.' diyor.
Zeynep, 'Top oynamak ister misin?' diye soruyor. Ali, 'Evet, oynayalım!' diyor. Birlikte top oynuyorlar. Mutlular.
